7 Brew Blondie Cold Brew: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Blondie Cold Brew is about $4.95, with 130 calories, 246 mg of caffeine and 22 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Blondie Cold Brew allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Blondie Cold Brew. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Blondie Cold Brew

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Blondie Cold Brew?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Blondie Cold Brew at Home (Copycat Recipe)

The trick is restraint: the stand build is one modest dose of flavor in a lot of cold brew, not a breve poured over ice. Make the cold brew first (our /cold-brew page has the standard 16-hour method), or use a store-bought concentrate cut about 1 to 1 with water.

For one medium Blondie Cold Brew (24 oz cup)

  • 1/2 oz vanilla syrup
  • 1/2 oz caramel syrup or sauce
  • About 12 oz cold brew (diluted, ready to drink)
  • A full cup of ice
  • Optional: a splash of milk, cream or half-and-half
  1. Pour the cold brew over the ice.
  2. Stir in the vanilla and caramel until dissolved.
  3. Add the splash of dairy only if you want it creamy, and stir once.

Extra sweet: go to 3/4 oz of each syrup, the fan move for this drink. Sugar-free attempt: sugar-free vanilla and caramel syrups exist, but 7 Brew publishes no official sugar-free version of this drink, so there is no official number to copy. Do not use the espresso Blondie recipe here: shots and half-and-half make the other drink entirely (480 calories in a medium).

7 Brew Blondie Cold Brew FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Blondie Cold Brew?

A medium iced Blondie Cold Brew has 130 calories. A small has 120 and a large 130, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Blondie Cold Brew?

About 246 mg in a medium. Small is 156 mg and large is 335 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Blondie Cold Brew cost?

Roughly $4.25 for a small, $4.95 for a medium and $5.75 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Blondie Cold Brew?

22 g in a medium.

What is a Blondie Cold Brew at 7 Brew?

Cold brew with vanilla and caramel syrup. That is the whole build: no espresso, and no half-and-half by default, which surprises people who know the original Blondie. Milk or cream is an add-on here, not the base. Brewistas note the flavor comes as one scoop whatever the size, which is why the sugar stays at 22 g in a small, medium and large alike.

Blondie Cold Brew vs the regular Blondie: which should I get?

They share two syrups and almost nothing else. The regular Blondie is an espresso breve in half-and-half: a medium iced runs 480 calories with 120 mg of caffeine. The Cold Brew version is 130 calories with 246 mg of caffeine. Dessert in a cup, get the breve. Coffee that happens to taste like dessert, get the cold brew.

Why do the calories barely change by size?

Because the flavor dose does not change. The guide lists 120 calories for a small, 130 for a medium and 130 for a large, with the same 22 g of sugar at every size. A large mostly buys you more cold brew and more caffeine (335 mg), not more sweetness. Some fan pages print a steep calorie curve for this drink. The official numbers are nearly flat.

Is there a sugar-free Blondie Cold Brew?

The official guide lists no sugar-free version of this drink, even though sugar-free vanilla and caramel syrups exist on the flavor list. If you order it built with those, treat the numbers as your own build, not an official one. The regular medium is 130 calories and 22 g of sugar. The drinks that do come sugar-free, all 43 of them, are compared on our sugar-free page.

How do I make a Blondie cold brew at home?

Pour cold brew over ice and stir in 1/2 oz vanilla syrup and 1/2 oz caramel syrup. Add a splash of milk or cream only if you want it creamy. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
